subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Most of the things in life are __transient.__
solution:
The correct answer is **"Permanent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Transient** means something that is not permanent or lasting.
 
• The antonym of **transient is permanent**, which means lasting or enduring.
 
• Other possible antonyms for transient could be** enduring, persistent, or long-lasting.**

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Boring:** Lacking interest or excitement.

 
 
• 
 
**Toxic: **Harmful, dangerous, or poisonous. 

 
 
• **Fleeting: **Something that is brief or passing quickly.
